name: The Array's Appetite
description: MERIDIAN-7 has requested refined umbrasite from the deep Nightside caverns. In exchange, it will provide an advanced Umbral Amplifier — a rare Sol component forged from the material itself.

accept_quest.label: Accept MERIDIAN-7's Request
accept_quest.description: Speak with MERIDIAN-7 at the Array Hub in Meridian City about the refined umbrasite.

find_umbrasite.label: Retrieve Refined Umbrasite
find_umbrasite.description: Descend into the Nightside Depths — past the deep perimeter, through the caverns — and recover a specimen of refined umbrasite.

return_to_meridian.label: Return to MERIDIAN-7
return_to_meridian.description: Bring the refined umbrasite back to MERIDIAN-7 at the Array Hub.
